{"path": "app.py", "content": "from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
# The pigpio daemon drives legacy mmio registers and is broken on the Pi 5
# (GPIO is on the RP1 southbridge via /dev/gpiochipN). gpiozero auto-selects lgpio.
led = LED(17)
led.on()
sleep(1)
"}

text: Fixed: the pigpio daemon drives legacy mmio registers and is broken on the Pi 5, whose GPIO is on the RP1 southbridge. Rewrote the script with gpiozero, which auto-selects lgpio on Pi 5.
